description: Build animated HeroSection component with community stats counters. Display total games, active players, tournaments with Framer Motion animations.
steps: Create components/games-hub/hero-section.js: React component that fetches GET /api/community/stats on mount
Render headline 'Connect. Compete. Elevate your game.' with subheading using display font
Implement animated stat counters using Framer Motion: animate from 0 to actual count over 1 second, staggered (100ms between each)
Icons pulse briefly when counter reaches target (use lucide-react icons: Users for active players, Zap for games, Trophy for tournaments)
Show loading skeleton while fetching stats (--  placeholders)
Include CTA buttons: 'Join a Game' (scrolls to games section) and 'View Tournaments' (scrolls to tournaments)
Responsive: full width on mobile, padded container on desktop, single column on mobile, three-column stat layout
acceptance_criteria: Stats counters animate on page load (0 → target, 1s duration)
Icons pulse when counter reaches target
verification: Run yarn dev, navigate to /games page
Observe hero section renders with headline and 3 stat counters
Watch stat counters animate from 0 on page load (duration ~1s per counter, staggered)
Resize window to <640px (sm), verify mobile layout
Click 'Join a Game' button, verify scroll to games section
Check browser console for errors (should be clean)
